description: This file is a shell script, specifically a test script for Gitpack-redundant functionality, containing test cases, setup functions, and comments describing packs and objects in different repository configurations.

methods.name: create_commits_in
methods.description: Creates a series of commits in a given repository and assigns their object IDs to specified variables.

methods.name: create_pack_in
methods.description: Creates a pack in a specified repository with commits read from stdin and assigns the pack id to a variable.
